title: Combat & Positioning
text: Move your partner through a 3D arena while its normal moves attack. Patterns include projectiles, beams, areas and close-range attacks. Space and positioning determine whether you can collect upgrades without taking unnecessary damage.

title: Leveling & Upgrade Choices
text: Experience brings level-up choices. You can learn a move when you have a free slot, improve an existing move or take a vitamin. Physical and special damage are distinct, so inspect the move you actually rely on before choosing a bonus.

title: In-run Evolution
text: Partners can evolve during a run under PokeBonk’s own rules. Traditional Pokédex evolution relationships do not confirm the current run-level requirement. Check the League and in-game evolution panel for your partner.

title: Catching & League Unlocks
text: Locked League partners show challenge requirements. Satisfying a challenge and capturing the newly available partner are separate steps. The 151-species Pokédex is a discovery collection, not a list of 151 starting partner choices.

title: Stardust & Permanent Growth
text: Stardust funds Lab purchases that carry into future runs. Extra move capacity, offer-control tools and permanent stat levels change your options. Run PokéDollars and vitamin bonuses are separate from this permanent balance.

title: Classic Mode & Regional Clears
text: Choose a region and difficulty, then work toward its clear objective. Learn the route and the guardian encounters with a familiar partner before comparing different builds. The checked Season 2 configuration includes Viridian Forest, Rocky Desert, Storm Coast and Celestial Glacier.

title: Survival Mode
text: An endurance setting with escalating pressure. v0.8.5 release notes changed horde acceleration after an hour and reduced movement-speed returns above ×3. Older strategies that rely on escaping forever should be rechecked.

title: Guardians & Boss Encounters
text: A guardian encounter asks you to keep reading the arena instead of standing still for pickups. Preserve room to move, use your current defensive tools and inspect the latest game rules for that encounter. We do not invent boss HP or damage values.

title: Move Levels & Fusion Stars
text: Normal moves reach level 8, or level 10 with TM Case. Bill’s Machine needs both ingredient moves at level 8 or higher. A fusion grows to ★5, or ★6 with TM Case. Weather, buff and existing fusion patterns are excluded from normal pair selection. Max Ether raises the vitamin level cap from 10 to 12; it does not raise the fusion cap.

title: Unlocks & Archive Capacity
text: Unlocking an item makes it eligible for offers; archiving it keeps it out of Poké Balls and Meowth’s shop. Archive has six Lab levels, adding five slots each. From level 1 onward, every two purchased unlocks from the 59-item unlock catalogue add one more slot. The maximum is 59 slots: 30 from levels and 29 from unlocks.

title: Build Plan & Favorites
text: The in-game Build Plan marks planned attacks, vitamins, fusions and items in offers. It does not grant items or buy slots. Its old six-item limit was removed in v0.8.45; locked or archived items still need attention before they are eligible. Favorites are selection shortcuts with no run-stat effect.

title: Mastery Looks
text: Each of the 79 League partners has two Mastery Looks challenges, adding 158 goals. Most now count in co-op: a win means the team wins, while other conditions check your own actions. Challenges allowing at most a specified number of hits remain solo-only. Read the exact move, difficulty and hit condition before starting; the reward changes appearance, not the partner’s kit.

title: Co-op Runs
text: Choose a map and difficulty unlocked by everyone in the room. You can bring Bag items: select them in the lobby; they are spent only if the run starts. Hold E beside a downed teammate to revive them. Opening a pause menu does not pause the match. An upgrade selection protects that player but stops their damage while choosing. A shrine legendary’s shiny roll is shared by the whole team.

title: Shop, Bag & Treasures
text: The menu Shop spends Stardust on Bag consumables with an item-specific daily purchase cap. Permanent Lab levels use a separate purchase screen. Treasures use Bonkoins and offer three wheels themed around Charmander, Bulbasaur and Squirtle; Bag items and cosmetic prizes serve different purposes from permanent stat upgrades.

title: Daily Mutation
text: A separate Classic challenge changes at 00:00 UTC. Metronome, Dynamax Wilds, Candy Fever and Crystal rotate through the four regions, each appearing once per four-day block. Pick any League partner and retry freely; your furthest progress comes first, then KOs. No Bag items or co-op. The first attack and Bill’s fusions are protected from Metronome swaps. Daily Stardust totals up to 300; titles, frames and profile backgrounds are permanent unlocks.
